name: Fourier Optics and Spatial Filtering
equations: U(x_f, y_f) = \frac{1}{i\lambda f}\iint U_0(x_0, y_0) e^{-i\frac{2\pi}{\lambda f}(x_0 x_f + y_0 y_f)} dx_0 dy_0
g(x,y) = f(x,y) * h(x,y) \iff G(f_x, f_y) = F(f_x, f_y) H(f_x, f_y)
methods: Place object in front focal plane of positive lens
Observe exact Fourier transform at back focal plane
Insert amplitude/phase mask at Fourier plane for spatial filtering
Use second lens to compute inverse Fourier transform (4f optical processor)
problem_types: Low-pass filtering to remove high-frequency noise and grain
High-pass filtering and dark-ground illumination for edge detection
Optical matched filtering for pattern recognition
pitfalls: Forgetting wavelength and focal length scaling in spatial frequency coordinates f_x = x / (lambda f)
Ignoring quadratic phase factor when object is not located at the front focal plane
